traits.summary: Resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision 60 feet.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.summary: Magic action, touch: the creature regains d4s equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.summary: You know the Light cantrip; Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Celestial Revelation
traits.summary: From character level 3, transform for 1 minute as a Bonus Action once per Long Rest, choosing Heavenly Wings, Inner Radiance or Necrotic Shroud each time; once per turn add extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

traits.name: Changeling Instincts
traits.summary: Proficiency in two skills chosen from Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Performance and Persuasion.

traits.name: Shape-Shifter
traits.summary: Action: change your appearance and voice, including height, weight and size between Medium and Small; game statistics and equipment stay the same. Advantage on Charisma checks while shifted; an action returns you to your true form.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision 60 feet.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

traits.name: Spider Climb (walls and ceilings)
traits.summary: From character level 3, move up, down and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings without using your hands.

traits.name: Trace of Undeath
traits.summary: Resistance to Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Vampiric Bite
traits.summary: An Unarmed Strike that deals damage can be a bite: Piercing damage equal to 1d4 + your Constitution modifier. Against a creature that is not a Construct or Undead, choose Drain (regain Hit Points equal to the Piercing damage) or Strengthen (that amount as a bonus to your next attack roll or ability check within 1 minute); Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description:
Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table. Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance traits as well as your appearance.

Table: Draconic Ancestors

| Dragon | Damage Type |
|---|---|
| Black | Acid |
| Blue | Lightning |
| Brass |Fire |
| Bronze | Lightning |
| Copper | Acid|
|Gold|Fire|
|Green|Poison|
|Red|Fire|
|Silver|Cold|
|White|Cold|

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description:
When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot Cone or a 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 damage of the type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by 1d10 when you reach character levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.description: When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a Bonus Action, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the Incapacitated condition. During that time, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Your wings appear to be made of the same energy as your Breath Weapon. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description:
As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this Tremorsense. The stone can be natural or worked.

You can use this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description:
You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

Table: Elven Lineages

|Lineage|Level 1|Level 3|Level 5|
|---|---|---|---|
|Drow|The range of your Darkvision increases to 120 feet. You also know the Dancing Lights cantrip.|Faerie Fire|Darkness|
|High Elf|You know the Prestidigitation cantrip. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.|Detect Magic|Misty Step|
|Wood Elf|Your Speed increases to 35 feet. You also know the Druidcraft cantrip.|Longstrider|Pass without Trace|

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.description:
You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose one of the following options; whichever one you choose, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage):

**Forest Gnome.** You know the *Minor Illusion* cantrip. You also always have the *Speak with Animals* spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.

**Rock Gnome.** You know the *Mending* and *Prestidigitation* cantrips. In addition, you can spend 10 minutes casting *Prestidigitation* to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP), such as a toy, fire starter, or music box. When you create the device, you determine its function by choosing one effect from *Prestidigitation*; the device produces that effect whenever you or another creature takes a Bonus Action to activate it with a touch. If the chosen effect has options within it, you choose one of those options for the device when you create it. For example, if you choose the spell's ignite-extinguish effect, you determine whether the device ignites or extinguishes fire; the device doesn't do both. You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it with a touch as a Utilize action.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description:
You are descended from Giants. Choose one of the following benefits—a supernatural boon from your ancestry; you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest:

- **Cloud's Jaunt (Cloud Giant)**. As a Bonus Action, you magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
- **Fire's Burn (Fire Giant)**. When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d10 Fire damage to that target.
- **Frost's Chill (Frost Giant)**. When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target and reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
- **Hill's Tumble (Hill Giant)**. When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can give that target the Prone condition.
- **Stone's Endurance (Stone Giant)**. When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total.
- **Storm's Thunder (Storm Giant)**. When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.description: Starting at character level 5, you can change your size to Large as a Bonus Action if you're in a big enough space. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes or until you end it (no action required). For that duration, you have Advantage on Strength checks, and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You have Advantage on any ability check you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't stop in the same space.

traits.name: Luck
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision 60 feet.

traits.name: Eerie Token
traits.summary: Bonus Action, once per Long Rest: make a token from your hair or nail. While it lasts (until your next Long Rest), a Magic action sends a telepathic message of up to 25 words to its holder within 10 miles, or lets you see and hear through it for up to 1 minute, after which it is destroyed.

traits.name: Hex Magic
traits.summary: Disguise Self and Hex are always prepared; cast each once per Long Rest without a spell slot or with slots of the right level. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is the spellcasting ability (chosen with the species).

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice (see "Feats"). Skilled is recommended.

traits.name: Dual Mind
traits.summary: Advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Mental Discipline
traits.summary: Resistance to Psychic damage.

traits.name: Mind Link
traits.summary: Telepathy with a range of 10 feet times your character level; a Magic action lets a creature you contact answer telepathically for 1 hour or until another Magic action ends it.

traits.name: Severed from Dreams
traits.summary: The Dream spell can't target you. After each Long Rest you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice until your next Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision 60 feet.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Fey Gift
traits.summary: You know the Friends cantrip; after each Long Rest you can swap it for another cantrip from the Cleric, Druid or Wizard list. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is the spellcasting ability (chosen with the species).

traits.name: Lethargy Resilience
traits.summary: When you fail a saving throw to avoid or end the Unconscious condition, you can succeed instead; then not again until you finish 1d4 Long Rests.

traits.name: Skill Versatility
traits.summary: Proficiency in one skill or tool of your choice; after each Long Rest you can swap it for another skill or tool.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision 60 feet.

traits.name: Feral Pounce
traits.summary: Your Unarmed Strikes deal Slashing damage instead of Bludgeoning. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use both its Damage and Shove options.

traits.name: Howl
traits.summary: Bonus Action: creatures of your choice within 15 feet make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or have Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn; Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

traits.name: Werewolf Instincts
traits.summary: Proficiency in Perception, Stealth or Survival.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description:
You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Escaped Death
traits.summary: Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

traits.name: Everlasting
traits.summary: No Exhaustion from dehydration, malnutrition or suffocation; no need to sleep and magic can't put you to sleep; a Long Rest takes 4 hours of inactivity during which you stay conscious.

traits.name: Knowledge from a Past Life
traits.summary: Proficiency in one skill of your choice. When you fail an ability check, you can roll 1d6 and add it to the check; Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

traits.name: Strange Endurance
traits.summary: Resistance to one damage type of your choice: Cold, Necrotic or Poison.

traits.name: Bestial Instincts
traits.summary: Proficiency in one of Acrobatics, Athletics, Intimidation or Survival.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision 60 feet.

traits.name: Shifting
traits.summary: Bonus Action: take a bestial form for 1 minute (a Bonus Action ends it early) and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus; Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Each time you also get the benefit chosen with the species: Beasthide, Longtooth, Swiftstride or Wildhunt.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.description:
You are the recipient of a legacy that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a legacy from the Fiendish Legacies table. You gain the level 1 benefit of the chosen legacy.

When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the legacy).

**Table: Fiendish Legacies**

|Legacy|Level 1|Level 3|Level 5|
|---|---|---|---|
|Abyssal|You have Resistance to Poison damage. You also know the Poison Spray cantrip.|Ray of Sickness|Hold Person|
|Chthonic|You have Resistance to Necrotic damage. You also know the Chill Touch cantrip.|False Life|Ray of Enfeeblement|
|Infernal|You have Resistance to Fire damage. You also know the Fire Bolt cantrip.|Hellish Rebuke|Darkness|

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: You know the *Thaumaturgy* cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the spell uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Fiendish Legacy trait.

traits.name: Constructed Resilience
traits.summary: Resistance to Poison damage; Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Integrated Protection
traits.summary: +1 bonus to Armor Class; armor you wear can't be removed against your will while you're alive.

traits.name: Sentry's Rest
traits.summary: No need to sleep and magic can't put you to sleep; a Long Rest takes 6 hours of inactivity during which you stay conscious.

traits.name: Specialized Design
traits.summary: Proficiency in one skill and one tool of your choice.

traits.name: Tireless
traits.summary: No Exhaustion from dehydration, malnutrition or suffocation.
